body.p: The elephant discovered water. It was the elephant who saw the water first. He hid his discovery from other people and drank it alone. He drank it all by himself. But the mud, the mud of the waterhole stuck to his legs so that after he had gone to sleep, ǃXõǁəmdima said "hey, everybody! What kind of man is this who has found water to drink and hasn't told us?"
But the next day her husband denied it, and said, "I haven't found any water to drink. It's only mud that you see here."

But there came another day when ǃXõǁəmdima said to her brothers, "Oh, people, I'm sure this husband of mine has found water and is keeping it from us. Let's go stand where we can watch. Let's find out what it is he is drinking." So they got up and followed his tracks and tracked him to where he had drunk the water and had then gone gathering. (Because the elephant eats trees, of course.) He went gathering and ate trees. Meanwhile ǃXõǁəmdima and her people went back to the waterhole and drank up all the water. Then they urinated into the waterhole until it was full of urine.

All this time the elephant was eating trees. When the sun was high in the sky he returned to the waterhole. It was full, and he thought it was plain water. He scooped up the urine with his trunk and began to drink. "Aagh!" He spat it out. It wasn't water at all! He looked over his shoulder. There were all of ǃXõǁəmdima's brothers sitting at the edge
of the waterhole. They were heating spears in a fire. The elephant saw his wife, too, sitting in her brothers' midst. The elephant ran towards them, thinking to pluck ǃXõǁəmdima away from her brothers with his trunk. But the brothers surrounded him. They attacked him, calling out to ǃXõǁəmdima, "We'll protect you! Today we're going to kill this elephant!" The brothers' spears clanged together. Their spears clanged together as they met inside the elephant's body. The brothers, who were the little rainbirds, darted here and there. With each dart they thrust their spears into the elephant. Soon he toppled over dead and they rolled him aside.
That is the story of how the elephant first found water. Since then the rain comes down and people have water to drink.
